title: CodeQL reflected-XSS alerts #14 and #15 lack a connector-owned request-header-to-body path
title_de: Den CodeQL-Reflected-XSS-Alerts #14 und #15 fehlt ein connector-eigener Request-Header-zu-Body-Pfad
protocol: net/http request-header inspection and transparent response streaming
summary: GitHub Code Scanning alerts #14 and #15 were dismissed as CodeQL go/reflected-xss false positives after immediate per-alert revalidation at Traefik native-middleware revision c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6. Their shared source is request.Header at middleware.go:356. Alert #14 reaches its reported sink only with an empty payload and therefore cannot emit a reflected body. Alert #15 transparently forwards a byte slice supplied by a Traefik-provided downstream handler; no Parent-owned code maps a request header, engine result, or metadata value into that slice. A real reflection still requires an external downstream handler to render a header in a browser-executable context.
summary_de: Die GitHub-Code-Scanning-Alerts #14 und #15 wurden nach einer unmittelbaren alert-spezifischen Revalidierung auf der Traefik-Native-Middleware-Revision c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6 als CodeQL-go/reflected-xss-False-Positives dismissed. Ihre gemeinsame Quelle ist request.Header in middleware.go:356. Alert #14 erreicht seinen gemeldeten Sink nur mit leerem Payload und kann daher keinen reflektierten Body ausgeben. Alert #15 leitet einen Byte-Slice eines von Traefik bereitgestellten Downstream-Handlers transparent weiter; kein Parent-Code bildet Request-Header, Engine-Ergebnis oder Metadaten in diesen Slice ab. Eine echte Reflexion erfordert weiterhin, dass ein externer Downstream-Handler einen Header in einem browser-ausführbaren Kontext rendert.
observed_behavior: Immediately before each authorized PATCH, GitHub showed alert #14 and #15 as open CodeQL go/reflected-xss results at c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6, with the shared source link middleware.go:356:40-54 and sinks 656:30-37 and 688:42-47 respectively. Local source and the retained task-owned Go boundary probe match that revision: request headers go to Transaction.ProcessHeaders; a disruptive decision returns before next.ServeHTTP; middleware-generated denial/failure bodies are fixed text/plain literals; #14 forwards only an empty payload; and #15 normal response chunks originate from the opaque downstream handler. GitHub then recorded #14 dismissed as false positive at 2026-07-18T08:55:32Z and #15 dismissed as false positive at 2026-07-18T08:58:49Z; fixed_at is null for both.
observed_behavior_de: Unmittelbar vor jedem autorisierten PATCH zeigte GitHub #14 und #15 als offene CodeQL-go/reflected-xss-Ergebnisse auf c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6, mit dem gemeinsamen Source-Link middleware.go:356:40-54 sowie den Sinks 656:30-37 beziehungsweise 688:42-47. Lokaler Source und der retained task-eigene Go-Boundary-Probe stimmen mit dieser Revision überein: Request-Header gehen zu Transaction.ProcessHeaders; eine disruptive Entscheidung kehrt vor next.ServeHTTP zurück; Middleware-generierte Deny-/Failure-Bodies sind feste text/plain-Literale; #14 leitet nur einen leeren Payload weiter; und normale Response-Chunks von #15 stammen vom opaken Downstream-Handler. GitHub zeichnete danach #14 am 2026-07-18T08:55:32Z und #15 am 2026-07-18T08:58:49Z jeweils als False Positive dismissed auf; fixed_at ist für beide null.

github_code_scanning_alerts.dismissed_comment: The reported sink is reachable only when len(payload) == 0 and therefore writes no response-body bytes. The reported source cannot be reflected through this sink. Focused boundary tests confirmed a zero-byte body.

The connector forwards bytes produced by an externally supplied downstream handler. It does not render the reported source into an HTML or browser execution context. Context-specific encoding remains the responsibility of any downstream renderer that constructs such content.

expected_behavior: The streaming adapter must not create a response body from request headers. It must preserve downstream bytes and media-type semantics while allowing precommit WAF intervention. Any handler that constructs an HTML, attribute, JavaScript, CSS, or URL response context from a request header must apply context-correct encoding at that handler.
expected_behavior_de: Der Streaming-Adapter darf keinen Response-Body aus Request-Headern erzeugen. Er muss Downstream-Bytes und Media-Type-Semantik bewahren und zugleich eine WAF-Intervention vor dem Commit erlauben. Jeder Handler, der aus einem Request-Header einen HTML-, Attribut-, JavaScript-, CSS- oder URL-Response-Kontext konstruiert, muss an diesem Handler kontextkorrekt encodieren.
impact: No connector-owned reflected-XSS defect is proven at either reported sink. Alert #14 is structurally non-exploitable, and alert #15 is a connector-local false positive because it forwards externally produced bytes without rendering request data. Both GitHub alerts are dismissed, not fixed. Alert #15 still requires a deployment-level application review if a concrete downstream handler becomes in scope. Applying generic escaping or forcing text/plain in this middleware would corrupt valid HTML, JSON, binary, already-encoded, and streaming responses without establishing a correct output context.
impact_de: An keinem gemeldeten Sink ist ein connector-eigener Reflected-XSS-Defekt belegt. Alert #14 ist strukturell nicht ausnutzbar, und Alert #15 ist ein connector-lokaler False Positive, weil er extern erzeugte Bytes weiterleitet, ohne Request-Daten zu rendern. Beide GitHub-Alerts sind dismissed, nicht fixed. Alert #15 erfordert weiterhin eine Deployment-Level-Anwendungsprüfung, falls ein konkreter Downstream-Handler in den Scope kommt. Generisches Escaping oder erzwungenes text/plain in dieser Middleware würde gültige HTML-, JSON-, Binär-, bereits encodierte und Streaming-Responses beschädigen, ohne einen korrekten Output-Kontext festzustellen.
preconditions: The alert revision remains c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6 or is revalidated on a later revision.
A concrete downstream reflection would require a Traefik-provided next handler to read a request header and write it into a browser-executable response context.
No such Parent-owned downstream handler was found in the scoped connector source.
reproduction: Query the current Code Scanning alert metadata and instances for #14 and #15 using authenticated read-only GitHub API access.
Run the retained xss_boundary_probe.go against the native middleware module with task-owned Go caches.
Inspect responseWriter.Write and ServeHTTP at the exact reported lines: #14 is guarded by len(payload)==0, and #15 receives a payload only through the downstream handler boundary.

rtk env GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOWORK=off GOCACHE=<task-run>/build/go-cache GOMODCACHE=<task-run>/cache/go-mod go run <task-run>/evidence/xss_boundary_probe.go

rtk env BUILD_ROOT=<task-run>/build TRAEFIK_NATIVE_MIDDLEWARE_BUILD_DIR=<task-run>/build/native-middleware GOCACHE=<task-run>/build/go-cache GOMODCACHE=<task-run>/cache/go-mod GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOWORK=off GO=go make -C connectors/traefik test-native-middleware; then build-native-middleware
rtk proxy gh api GET/PATCH/GET projections for alerts 14 and 15, with immediate local SHA/source/FND evidence comparison before each PATCH

root_cause: Both CodeQL results cross the same generic handler/writer callback boundary. The query sees a request-header source and generic response body writes but the scoped connector code does not construct a response body from that source. Alert #14 additionally lacks the path-sensitive fact that its payload is empty. Alert #15 needs an unknown downstream renderer to bridge the source to the chunk argument.
root_cause_de: Beide CodeQL-Ergebnisse überqueren dieselbe generische Handler/Writer-Callback-Grenze. Die Query sieht eine Request-Header-Quelle und generische Response-Body-Writes, aber der abgegrenzte Connector-Code konstruiert aus dieser Quelle keinen Response-Body. Alert #14 fehlt zusätzlich die pfadsensitive Tatsache, dass sein Payload leer ist. Alert #15 benötigt einen unbekannten Downstream-Renderer, um die Quelle mit dem Chunk-Argument zu verbinden.
proposed_remediation: Do not change or suppress the transparent middleware. The current connector-local Code Scanning results were dismissed as false positives from exact retained and revalidated evidence. If a concrete deployed next handler is brought into scope and reflects a header, remediate that renderer with context-specific output encoding and its own regression/control/bypass tests.
proposed_remediation_de: Die transparente Middleware weder ändern noch unterdrücken. Die aktuellen connector-lokalen Code-Scanning-Ergebnisse wurden auf Basis exakter retained und revalidierter Evidence als False Positives dismissed. Falls ein konkreter bereitgestellter Next-Handler in den Scope kommt und einen Header reflektiert, diesen Renderer mit kontextspezifischem Output-Encoding und eigenen Regression-/Control-/Bypass-Tests remediieren.
acceptance_criteria: Alert #14 is authoritatively dismissed only while the zero-byte branch proof, exact source/sink, and analyzed revision match the retained evidence.
Alert #15 is dismissed only for the connector-local boundary and is not treated as a connector fix or a deployment-wide renderer assessment.
Any future renderer remediation preserves correct HTML, attribute, JavaScript, URL, JSON, binary, and already-encoded behavior for its actual context.
No alert is dismissed, security control weakened, or master change made without current technical evidence and authority.
validation_plan: Rerun the authenticated alert and analysis query on every changed target SHA before altering a dismissal or relying on the disposition.
Rerun the focused boundary probe and native middleware test/vet/build target after any affected code change.
If a downstream renderer is identified, test its actual browser context and response Content-Type instead of applying a generic proxy transformation.
regression_tests: Task-owned xss_boundary_probe.go: safe non-empty forwarding, #14 zero write, and pre-request fixed denial.
connectors/traefik target test-native-middleware (go test ./... and go vet ./...).
connectors/traefik target build-native-middleware (go test, vet, and build).
legitimate_control_tests: Safe HTML-content-type downstream response preserves safe-body for HTML, attribute, script, URL, encoded, empty, Unicode, and invalid-UTF-8 probe variants without reflection.
A denial retains fixed text/plain content and does not invoke the downstream handler.
The deliberately unsafe downstream HTML echo preserves its input exactly, demonstrating ownership lies in that downstream renderer.
dependencies: A specific Traefik deployment and its next handler are outside the Parent connector source scope.
The two GitHub Code Scanning dismissals are scoped to the analyzed connector revision and do not assess or accept downstream deployment risk.
residual_risk: Alert #14 has no component-local reflected-body path. Alert #15 can still be part of a real application-level reflected XSS only when a downstream handler chooses an HTML, script, attribute, or URL context and reflects a header without context-correct encoding; that deployment-level path is not proven, assessed, remediated, or risk-accepted here. The GitHub dismissals are connector-local false-positive dispositions, not product fixes.
residual_risk_de: Alert #14 hat keinen component-lokalen reflektierten Body-Pfad. Alert #15 kann weiterhin Teil eines realen Application-Level-Reflected-XSS sein, wenn ein Downstream-Handler einen HTML-, Script-, Attribut- oder URL-Kontext wählt und einen Header ohne kontextkorrektes Encoding reflektiert; dieser Deployment-Level-Pfad ist hier weder belegt, untersucht, remediated noch risikoakzeptiert. Die GitHub-Dismissals sind connector-lokale False-Positive-Dispositionen, keine Produkt-Fixes.

history.detail: Authenticated current alert metadata, source-to-sink reconstruction, a focused Go boundary probe, and native connector test/vet/build evidence established no connector-owned request-header-to-body path. No product fix, alert dismissal, GitHub state change, or risk acceptance was performed.

Immediately before each authorized PATCH, alerts #14 and #15 were revalidated as open go/reflected-xss results at c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6 with source middleware.go:356:40-54 and sinks 656:30-37 / 688:42-47 matching retained evidence. GitHub dismissed #14 at 2026-07-18T08:55:32Z and #15 at 2026-07-18T08:58:49Z with reason false positive and the required comments; fixed_at is null for both. No product fix, risk acceptance, commit, pull request, Framework/MRTS change, or gitlink change occurred.

Closed after a read-only confirmation that alerts #14 and #15 remain dismissed as false positive at c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6, with the documented sources, sinks, retained evidence, and fixed_at null still matching. final_disposition is false_positive_in_connector_scope; feasibility_status remains not_applicable because no connector patch is required. The sole remaining risk is an external downstream renderer that emits unsafe context-dependent output. Separate shared temporary-root finalization is tracked by FND-HOST-0005 and does not block this connector-scope closure. No GitHub mutation, product change, Framework/MRTS change, gitlink change, commit, push, or pull request occurred.
